verdict: Yes. AToddler Thing from Coimbatore pitched baby clothing and essentials on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Parents pay for soft, safe fabrics and buy often because babies grow quickly. Tiruppur's knitwear cluster makes this a natural business for South India.
angle: Organic cotton, muslin and safe dyes are what parents look for. Gifting at births and baby showers adds a second market. Babies outgrow clothes in months, so repeat purchases are frequent, but you'll need many sizes, so start with a narrow range.

faq_extra.q: Which fabrics sell best for baby clothes?
faq_extra.a: Organic or combed cotton and muslin are most in demand. Parents also look for nickel-free snaps, no rough seams and certified safe dyes.
